# Frontend Quality Instructions

## Overview
Frontend quality for Blazor ensures usability, performance, and accessibility.

## Guidelines
- Follow Blazor best practices.
- Use ARIA for accessibility.
- Optimize bundle size in WASM.
- Test components with bUnit.
- Ensure responsive and mobile-friendly.

## Tools
- bUnit for unit testing components.
- Bootstrap for styling.

## Metrics
- Lighthouse scores for performance.
- Accessibility audits.
